comments.body: The large periodic #guards call `agrees`, which checks only size and CRC32. That is not the byte-for-byte golden comparison required by the task; distinct compressed streams can have the same size and CRC. `check.py` compares bytes, but it is not run by `lake test` or `verify.sh`. Make the #guards for the under/over-10000 cases compare the full compressed bytes against the vendored golden output (or arrange an equivalent byte comparison in the required test path).

This citation is wrong: `blocksort.c:1083-1088` finds `origPtr`; the choice of `fallbackSort` for blocks below 10000 bytes is at `blocksort.c:1044-1046`. Please cite the decision lines here, as STYLE.md requires.

last.summary: The sorter implementation matched the vendored compressor on the 24 supplied byte-exact vectors, 108 additional periodic threshold cases, and 9 block-boundary/sample cases. `verify.sh` passed: `verify: packages: ok`, `verify: sources: ok`, `verify: build: ok`, `verify: style: ok`, `verify: axioms: ok`, `verify: lint: ok`, `verify: test: ok`, `verify: ok`. The named fuzz harness and a task-specific check are absent. Two task-required fixes remain: make the large golden #guards compare actual bytes, and correct the fallback-threshold citation.
